FISCAL NOTE
House Bill 137
Committee: State Government Sponsor: Representative Chris Pringle
Analyst: Hunter Lapp Date: 01/19/2026
House Bill 137 as introduced could increase the administrative obligations of the Governor's
office by an undetermined amount to certify the immediate danger to public health, safety, or
welfare to the Contract Review Permanent Legislative Committee to justify the use of an
emergency contract. This bill would otherwise not affect state or local funding.
